row: Simple Self Care - Living Lotus Massage

My name is Shannon, I am a Mobile Massage Therapist in the Bay Area, CA and own Living Lotus Massage. This channel is for me to share Self Care tips, inspire with health education backed with science AND Woo-Woo insight, give clients a peek into the craziness of my real life & business behind the scenes, and so much more!

Join me on the adventures being a Mama, Wife and Business Owner, working on myself through: anxiety, PTSD, traumas and my new ventures (like: my Mermaid Woo-Woo side @celestialmermaidmt on Instagram)

Massage isn't just bodywork to me, I honestly feel like if you aren't including your Mind and Spirit in the bodywork, you are missing a huge component, as EVERYTHING IS CONNECTED... let's chat about it!! :D
